info.name: Nukhba Alawael API
info.description:
Generated from the NestJS controllers. Global prefix is /api. Success responses are wrapped as { message, data }.

Auth: run Auth > Login first — a test script stores data.accessToken / data.refreshToken into collection variables, and every guarded request inherits Bearer {{accessToken}}.

Roles: admin (user/manage, school/manage, curriculum/admin, public-content writes), contentWriter (curriculum/school tree, books), public (auth, files, curriculum metaData/tracks, public-content reads).

The test script stores `accessToken` / `refreshToken` into the collection variables.

BookEditDto: `name?`, `text?` only — the lesson cannot be moved.

status: draft | published.

Publishing requires the lesson to already have at least one question, and a published lesson cannot then be emptied — set it back to draft to delete its last question.

request.description:
QuestionGetDto: `skip`, `limit`, `sort`, `title`, `lessonId`, `courseId`.

The controller rejects the request unless **exactly one** of `lessonId` / `courseId` is present.

QuestionCreateDto + QuestionOptionGroupDto.

`optionGroups[].index` must start at 0 and be sequential; each group needs ≥2 options and ≥1 `isCorrect`. `title` on a group is optional.

Need an image on create? Use the form-data variant below — it accepts the same nested shape.

formdata.description: Enable and pick a file to attach an image.

request.description:
Same QuestionCreateDto as the JSON request, sent as form-data — the only way to attach `image` on create.

Multipart works because multer parses bracket notation (`append-field`) and every numeric/boolean field on this path carries a `@Transform`.

Repeat the index for more groups (`optionGroups[1][…]`) — group indexes must start at 0 and stay sequential. Use `tips[0]`, `tips[1]`: a bare `tips` key would arrive as a string and fail `@IsArray()`.

Still JSON-only: **fillBlanks** — `fillBlanks[].index` has no `@Transform`, so it arrives as a string and fails `@IsInt()`.
`correctAnswer` (boolean) is the answer key; it is stored in the dedicated QuestionTrueOrFalse row.

Minimum 3 items. `correctIndex` on a **base** row is the position of its match **inside this array** (0-based).

Rules: matches ≥ bases, every base needs a correctIndex, a match may serve only one base, and a base may not point at another base.

Minimum 2 rows, at least one `category` and one `item`.

`correctCategoryIndex` on an **item** is the position of its category **inside this array**; categories must not carry one.
Minimum 2 items, sent **in their correct order** — the array position becomes `sort`. The student receives them shuffled.

The `title` MUST carry one placeholder per blank, in exactly this syntax:

`{{textField:{width:<int>,contentLength:<int|null>,index:<int>}}}`

Placeholder count and indexes must match `fillBlanks[].index`, which starts at 0 and is sequential. Each blank accepts a list of answers (any match counts).

Note: Postman leaves the unresolved `{{textField…}}` token untouched — that is intended, it is part of the question text.
`purpose: dailyChallenge` swaps `lessonId` for `courseId` — the question joins that course’s pool and is never shown inside a lesson. Sending `lessonId` here is rejected, and vice-versa.

formdata.description: options | trueFalse | match | classify | order | fillBlanks

request.description:
Multipart is the only way to attach `image` on create.

It works for `options`, `trueFalse`, `match`, `classify` and `order`. **fillBlanks** stays JSON-only: `fillBlanks[].index` has no `@Transform`, so multipart delivers it as a string and `@IsInt()` rejects it.
QuestionBulkCreateDto: `{ questions: QuestionCreateDto[] }` — same shapes as the single-create requests, no image support. All rows are created in one transaction.

QuestionEditDto whitelists **only** `title` and `tips`. Sending `type`, `purpose`, `lessonId`, `optionGroups`, … is rejected (forbidNonWhitelisted) — the answer key is immutable; delete and recreate instead.

`tips` replaces the whole list (`[]` clears it). Editing a fillBlanks `title` re-validates its placeholders. A lesson already used by a student rejects every question edit.

formdata.description: repeat the key for several tips

request.description: Same DTO, multipart — the only way to replace `image`. The old file is soft-removed and cleaned up by the LISTEN/NOTIFY listener.

By id.

Rejected when the question is the LAST one of a `published` lesson — set the lesson to `draft` first. Also rejected while today's daily challenge uses it.

Deleting the whole lesson or unit tears its questions down regardless (guards are skipped there).

By ids. POST rather than DELETE because DELETE bodies get dropped by some proxies.

All-or-nothing: one undeletable question cancels the batch. Same guards as single delete.
Returns `{ challenges, unUsedQuestions }` — one challenge per allowed track for today, plus the remaining dailyChallenge-pool count per course.
Manual trigger of the midnight cron. Idempotent per (school, track, date); picks `AppConfig.DAILY_CHALLENGE_QUESTIONS_PER_COURSE` questions per course out of the never-used pool.

request.description:
SolvingStartLessonDto. Returns `{ snapshotId, lesson, questions }` with the answer keys stripped; the snapshot freezes the questions for this attempt and marks the lesson as used.

The test script stores `snapshotId`.

SolvingSnapshotDto: `{ snapshotId, answers }`.

One field per question type — mixing them is rejected (`options is not allowed for trueFalse answers`):

- `options`    → `{ options: [{ answered: <optionId>, index: <groupIndex> }] }` (one entry per group)
- `trueFalse`  → `{ boolAnswer: true }`
- `match`      → `{ matches: [{ baseId, matchId }] }`
- `classify`   → `{ classify: [{ categoryId, items: [itemId] }] }`
- `order`      → `{ orders: [{ id, order }] }` (order 0-based, unique, sequential)
- `fillBlanks` → `{ fillBlanks: [{ index, answer }] }`

Question ids must be unique in `answers`; an omitted question counts as skipped.

Returns the verdict result (`verdicts`, `correct`, `total`, `skipped`, `score`, `passed`) plus the awarded `xps` / `gems`. The snapshot is consumed; wrong questions are auto-saved.

Starts today's challenge for the student's own (school, track). No body. Returns `{ snapshotId, questions }`.

Rejects with 400 if the student already attempted today, 404 if no challenge exists yet.
